newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria ready for U.N. mission on Bakassi.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria ready for U.N. mission on Bakassi.

text.p: Nigeria has agreed to cooperate with a United Nations mission to examine its dispute with Cameroon over Bakassi peninsula in the oil-rich Gulf of Guinea, state-run radio said on Friday.
It quoted a U.N. spokeswoman in New York as saying a letter had been received from Nigeria's military ruler, General Sani Abacha, expressing willingness for the mission to go ahead.
"Now we have both Cameroon and Nigeria which have agreed to cooperate," the spokeswoman was quoted as saying.
The radio did not mention any date for a possible mission.
Since February 1994, Nigerian and Cameroonian troops have clashed over the string of impoverished islands which form the Bakassi peninsula.
In March, the International Court of Justice at The Hague ordered the two sides to halt hostilities pending its final decision on who owns the peninsula.
